content.title: Current Crime Trends and Crime Prevention Class
content.summary: A Crime Prevention Class will take place on July 23, 2026, from 6 p.m. to 8 p.m. at Arvada Police Headquarters, focusing on crime trends, prevention tips, and community involvement. Participants can learn about reporting crime, protecting their neighborhoods, and ask questions during a Q&A session. For registration or more information, contact Jeff Hatcliff at 720-898-6883 or via email.
content.body:
The next Crime Prevention Class will be held Thursday, July 23, 2026, at Arvada Police Headquarters, from 6 p.m. to 8 p.m.

This two-hour class is geared towards citizens interested in learning basic crime prevention tips and tools to help reduce crime. The topics that are covered in this class include:

- New crime trends
- Crime prevention tips for you and your home
- Reporting crime
- Vacation tips
- How the police respond to calls
- Protecting your neighborhood
- How to be a good witness
- Good habits
- Overall questions and your specific concerns

The class will also cover crime and statistics and how to become more involved with the Neighbors Connected program. A question-and-answer period will be offered.

For more information or to register please call 720-898-6883 or email Jeff Hatcliff at [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#abc1c3cadfc8c7c2cdcdebcad9ddcacfca85c4d9cc).

Additional classes may be scheduled upon request and conducted based on enrollment levels.
